high_level_description: The image appears to be a screenshot from a presentation at the Reinforcement Learning Conference, as indicated by the logo in the top right corner. The slide is titled "Agent architecture should make no design-time commitments to any particular world," which suggests a discussion about the flexibility and adaptability of AI agent designs. The slide contains a quote from "The Bitter Lesson" by Sutton (2019), which reads: "...the actual contents of minds are ... part of the arbitrary, intrinsically-complex, outside world.
